summary: Novel-command parsers now read AppTweak's {"result": {"<app id>": ...}} envelope (rank-fanout, track, paid-organic-gap, metadata-diff, reviews sentiment, credits status); rank lookups send metrics=rank and are limited to 5 keywords per request.
reason: The parsers looked for content/data/results keys that AppTweak never returns. metadata-diff reported every field as unchanged, and the others returned empty results, once the endpoint paths were fixed. Verified against captured live responses; envelope_test.go covers each shape.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli passes; each novel command returned real data live.
